description: This file defines the App class within the Goteo application, which extends Symfony's HttpKernel. It manages core application functionalities such as request handling, route management, dependency injection, service container access, error handling, and application lifecycle control.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application class extending Symfony's HttpKernel, responsible for managing requests, services, routes, errors, and application lifecycle.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Retrieves the current Request object, creating one from globals if not already set.

methods.name: setRequest
methods.description: Sets the current Request object, allowing for custom requests.

methods.name: getServiceContainer
methods.description: Returns the dependency injection service container, loading it from a PHP file if not already initialized.

methods.name: setServiceContainer
methods.description: Sets the service container instance explicitly.

methods.name: isService
methods.description: Checks if a specific service exists in the container.

methods.name: getService
methods.description: Retrieves a service from the container by name.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches an event through the event dispatcher service.

methods.name: getRoutes
methods.description: Retrieves the route collection, loading from a PHP file if not already set.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the App, initializing it with request, routes, and service container if necessary.

methods.name: debug
methods.description: Enables or disables debug mode, affecting error reporting, profiling, and SQL query collection.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the app kernel's handle method to process a request and send the response.

methods.name: clearApp
methods.description: Resets the singleton app instance and related static properties.

methods.name: getErrors
methods.description: Returns the list of errors collected by the custom error handler.

methods.name: errorHandler
methods.description: Custom error handler that logs errors, collects trace info, and formats error output.
